L110: ## 【25†Core Concepts】 L111: ### 【26†Viewport & Auto-Scroll】 L112: `Viewport` is the scrollable container. It auto-scrolls to the bottom as new content streams in, but only if the user hasn't scrolled up manually. L113: Expanding a disclosure inside a message, such as a collapsible tool call card (a control with `aria-expanded="false"` that opens no popup, or the `` of a closed `
`), pauses it so the card stays where the user opened it; other clicks, text selection and keystrokes keep following, and scrolling back to the bottom or using `ThreadPrimitive.ScrollToBottom` resumes it. A new run or a thread switch also ends the pause. Set `autoScroll={false}` to disable this entirely. User agents should follow platform conventions, if any.
